description: This file defines interfaces for a log view adaptor used in Orleans' event sourcing framework. It includes interfaces for reading, updating, and managing log views and entries, as well as lifecycle hooks for activation and deactivation.

methods.name: PreOnActivate
methods.description: Called during activation, right before the user-defined Grain.OnActivateAsync.

methods.name: PostOnActivate
methods.description: Called during activation, right after the user-defined Grain.OnActivateAsync.

methods.name: PostOnDeactivate
methods.description: Called during deactivation, right after the user-defined Grain.OnDeactivateAsync.

methods.name: RetrieveLogSegment
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a segment of the log between specified versions; may throw NotSupportedException.

methods.name: Submit
methods.description: Submits a single log entry to be appended to the global log.

methods.name: SubmitRange
methods.description: Submits a range of log entries to be appended atomically.

methods.name: TryAppend
methods.description: Attempts to append a single log entry at the current position; returns success status.

methods.name: TryAppendRange
methods.description: Attempts to append multiple log entries atomically; returns success status.

methods.name: ConfirmSubmittedEntries
methods.description: Confirms all submitted entries, waiting until they appear in the confirmed prefix.

methods.name: Synchronize
methods.description: Gets the latest log view and confirms all submitted entries, forcing a refresh of the confirmed prefix.
